notes:
- **Halloween week.** The app dresses up for Halloween — this year starting
  right now, and from then on every year from October 25th to 31st: orange
  instead of yellow, cobwebs in the corners, spiders dangling over the menus
  and bats flapping past now and then (none of them get in the way of your
  clicks, and they stay out of the player), and a glowing **Halloween** entry
  in the sidebar with a countdown to the big night. It opens **Fright Night picks** from the library,
  sorted into shelves — *Halloween Night Classics*, *Haunted & Possessed*,
  *New Nightmares*, *Family Frights* for the kids, *Creature Features* and
  *Spooky Comedies* — plus any collection with "Halloween" in its name. Got a
  different nightmare in mind? The button at the bottom takes you straight to
  **Add media**. It switches itself off after the 31st and comes back by
  itself every Halloween week.
- **Prefer the usual look?** Settings → Playback → **Seasonal look** turns off
  the orange, the spiders and the bats (from the next launch); the Halloween
  page stays either way.

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
